# The portal news tab bar clips its last tabs on portrait phones

## Context

#20594 (the Videos tab, merged as `36e1805e99`) gave the portal's news section its seventh tab. The operator asked for a follow-up: check the left-docked tab bar at portrait phone sizes, because one more tab could make it tight. Landscape is out of scope.

## The Problem

I measured at `dev` `36e1805e99` on the dev server, headless, with Playwright's device descriptors. Each descriptor's viewport is the visible page area, smaller than the device screen by the browser and system bars: `iPhone 13` is 390×664 of a 390×844 screen.

- The seven rotated labels stack from 108 px to 883 px below the page top. Above them sit the 58 px portal header and the bar's 50 px top padding below 640 px width. The buttons are 81–142 px tall.
- `.portal-main-content` clips with `overflow-y: hidden`, and the bar does not scroll, so a tab below the visible height cannot be reached.

| Descriptor | Visible viewport | Last fully visible tab | Cut off |
|---|---|---|---|
| `iPhone SE` | 320×568 | Blog | Medium (partly), Pull Requests, Videos |
| `iPhone 12 Mini` | 375×629 | Blog | Medium (partly), Pull Requests, Videos |
| `iPhone 13` | 390×664 | Medium | Pull Requests (11 px showing), Videos |
| `iPhone 15 Pro Max` | 430×739 | Medium | Pull Requests (partly), Videos |
| `Pixel 7` | 412×839 | Pull Requests | Videos (47 of 92 px showing) |

The live 13.3.1 site has six tabs, ending at 792 px, so Pull Requests is already cut off at every viewport above except `Pixel 7`. A real phone gains height when its browser toolbars collapse; the table is the expanded-toolbar case. The Videos tab reaches neomjs.com with 13.4. On these viewports its header would be hidden, and it would be reachable only by its route, `#/news/videos`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Portal.view.shared.TabContainer` (`apps/portal/view/shared/TabContainer.mjs`) sets `tabBarPosition: 'left'`. `Portal.view.news.TabContainer` and `Portal.view.examples.TabContainer` extend it. The news subclass passes its own `headerToolbar` (`cls` only).
- `resources/scss/src/apps/portal/news/TabContainer.scss` adds the 50 px top padding below 640 px, so the side-nav toggle stops covering the first tab (#8440).
- The engine already ships the overflow behaviour. `Neo.tab.plugin.Overflow` (`src/tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs`) measures the header toolbar's main axis, which is height for a `left` or `right` dock. It moves headers that don't fit behind one control (`fa-ellipsis-vertical` on a vertical bar), whose menu activates them through the container's existing `activeIndex`. `examples/tab/container/MainContainer.mjs` enables it as `headerToolbar: {plugins: [{module: TabOverflow}]}`.

Design authority: `Neo.tab.plugin.Overflow`'s `@summary`, "when headers exceed the available main-axis extent, overflowing tabs collapse behind one control whose menu reaches them."

## The Fix

Enable `Neo.tab.plugin.Overflow` on the header toolbar of `Portal.view.shared.TabContainer`, so the news and examples sections both get it. `tab.Container#headerToolbar` is a plain config, so a subclass value replaces the parent's. The `headerToolbar` block that both subclasses repeat therefore moves into the shared class, and both copies are deleted. No portal-specific overflow code.

Choosing a hidden tab from the menu sets only `activeIndex`, which leaves a routed tab's URL on the old route: after choosing Videos it reads `#/news/releases/13.3.1`. The plugin therefore carries each hidden button's route policy into its menu item. `Neo.menu.List` navigates a plain `route` after its handler, while an `editRoute` header's item merges through `Neo.Main.editRoute` and carries no route, so other hash fields survive. Tabs without a route keep the `activeIndex`-only selection.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: At 390×664 and at 320×568 portrait, every news tab is either fully visible in the bar or listed in the overflow control's menu. Choosing Videos from the menu activates `#/news/videos`.
- [ ] AC-2: At 1920×1080 the news bar shows all seven tabs and no overflow control.
- [ ] AC-3: The examples section's bar is unchanged wherever its tabs fit.
- [ ] AC-4: A portal e2e spec drives the 390×664 case. It fails on `36e1805e99`, where Videos is neither visible nor in a menu, and passes with the fix.

## Out of Scope

- Landscape orientation.
- The bar's visual design: rotated labels, icons, the 640 px top padding.

## Avoided Traps

- **Hiding labels below a breakpoint:** a design change that only moves the limit, since each new tab still costs height.
- **`overflow-y: auto` on the bar:** a touch scroll with no affordance, so hidden tabs stay undiscoverable.
- **Portal-specific overflow code:** the engine plugin already handles left-docked bars.
